deviations.what: c7 S4 *A/C statement · add the opening balance*: the sheet is built and captured (S4__add-opening) — title 'Ramesh Kumar, before today', 'What was already owed before you started this khata.', 'They owe you / You owe them', the amount, 'You will get ₹2,500 in all.' with the figure emphasised as the frame draws it (semibold, money-in green — money-out red for 'give'; matched in the 2026-10-10 re-pair, the rest of the sentence muted) and 'Recorded as the opening balance on 31 Aug 2026, the day this book starts.', Cancel / Save. Remaining differences: the selected segment is filled bahi red with paper words (the frame: a raised paper pill with green words and a green ↓ on a sunk track); the amount is an underlined Material field with a small '₹ 2000' (the frame: a large filled box '₹ 2,000' with a navy outline); the date line follows the total on its own line (the frame runs them on as one paragraph); the frame's sheet title uses the short name 'Ramesh'; the frame's date '1 Apr 2026' is its own book's start, the app's '31 Aug 2026' the capture fixture's. When the book's first month is locked the date line reads '… on <first day of the earliest open month>, the first open month — the month this book starts in is closed.' (ADR 2026-09-09d §4) — a state the canvas does not draw
deviations.reason: [shared] segmented control and text field are the theme's (app/lib/shared/theme.dart), not this screen's. The title uses the A/C name as the person wrote it — the app has no short-name field. The total and the date are separate sentences in the ARB (ledger.opening_sheet.total_* / dated / dated_locked), so each stays one translatable unit in PA/HI; they are set as two lines rather than concatenated. On Android 360 the two actions stack (Save over Cancel) by measurement, not by scale: reflow, not a defect
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-07b §2 🔒; ADR 2026-09-09d §4 🔒 (locked start month); ADR 2026-10-05 §1; design-system segmented / text-field components; 01 §1.8 (strings through ARB); 07 §1 rule 9
